name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_cough_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of cough.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of cough.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of cough.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of cough.

name: patient_has_finding_of_dyspnea_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of dyspnea (breathlessness).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of dyspnea (breathlessness).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of dyspnea (breathlessness).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of dyspnea (breathlessness).

name: patient_has_finding_of_tight_chest_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of chest tightness.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of chest tightness.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of chest tightness.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of chest tightness.

name: patient_has_finding_of_wheezing_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of wheezing.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of wheezing.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of wheezing.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of wheezing.

name: patient_has_physician_diagnosed_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has physician-diagnosed asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma made by a physician.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of asthma made by a physician.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma made by a physician.

name: patient_has_typical_asthma_symptom_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has at least one typical asthma symptom (wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, or cough).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has at least one typical asthma symptom (wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, or cough).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any of the typical asthma symptoms (wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, or cough).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has any typical asthma symptoms.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_asthma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of asthma.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a confirmed diagnosis of asthma.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a confirmed diagnosis of asthma.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a confirmed diagnosis of asthma.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric percent increase in FEV1 measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured percent increase in FEV1 after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol, recorded now.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent@@after_inhalation_of_400_micrograms_salbutamol
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the percent increase in FEV1 was measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_true: Set to true if the percent increase in FEV1 is measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_false: Set to false if the percent increase in FEV1 is not measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the measurement was taken after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_milliliters
meaning: Numeric absolute increase in FEV1 (milliliters) measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured absolute increase in FEV1 (in milliliters) after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol, recorded now.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_milliliters@@after_inhalation_of_400_micrograms_salbutamol
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the absolute increase in FEV1 (milliliters) was measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_true: Set to true if the absolute increase in FEV1 (milliliters) is measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_false: Set to false if the absolute increase in FEV1 (milliliters) is not measured after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the measurement was taken after inhalation of 400 micrograms salbutamol.

name: patient_methacholine_pc20_value_recorded_now_withunit_milligrams_per_milliliter
meaning: Numeric value of methacholine PC20 (mg/mL) measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured provocative concentration of methacholine (PC20) in milligrams per milliliter that causes a 20% fall in FEV1, measured now.

name: patient_forced_expired_volume_in_1_second_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent@@after_exposure_to_methacholine
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the percent fall in FEV1 was measured after exposure to methacholine.
when_true: Set to true if the percent fall in FEV1 is measured after exposure to methacholine.
when_false: Set to false if the percent fall in FEV1 is not measured after exposure to methacholine.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the measurement was taken after exposure to methacholine.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_methacholine_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to methacholine.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently exposed to methacholine as part of a bronchoprovocation test.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently exposed to methacholine.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently exposed to methacholine.

name: patient_asthma_confirmed_by_protocol_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether asthma is confirmed by protocol as defined in the requirement.
when_true: Set to true if asthma is confirmed by protocol as defined in the requirement.
when_false: Set to false if asthma is not confirmed by protocol as defined in the requirement.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether asthma is confirmed by protocol.

name: patient_sputum_eosinophils_rate_value_recorded_now_withunit_percent
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's sputum eosinophils rate (%) measured now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric measurement of the patient's sputum eosinophils rate (%) recorded now is available.

name: absolute_blood_eosinophils_count_value_recorded_in_cubic_millimeter
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's absolute blood eosinophils count in per cubic millimeter.
when_unknown: Set to null if the absolute blood eosinophils count is not available, not measured, or cannot be determined in per cubic millimeter.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's absolute blood eosinophils count as measured in per cubic millimeter.

name: patient_has_undergone_inhaled_steroid_therapy_inthepast3months
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy during the previous three months.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy at any time during the previous three months.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy at any time during the previous three months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy during the previous three months.

name: patient_has_undergone_inhaled_steroid_therapy_inthepast3months@@administered_at_a_stable_dose
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the inhaled corticosteroid therapy during the previous three months was administered at a stable dose.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy during the previous three months and the therapy was administered at a stable dose.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone inhaled corticosteroid therapy during the previous three months but the therapy was not administered at a stable dose.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the therapy was administered at a stable dose during the previous three months.

name: patient_has_finding_of_near_fatal_asthma_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever had near-fatal asthma in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever had a clinical finding of near-fatal asthma at any point in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had a clinical finding of near-fatal asthma in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever had near-fatal asthma.

name: patient_required_stay_in_intensive_care_unit_in_the_history
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever required a stay in an intensive care unit in the past.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever required a stay in an intensive care unit at any point in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never required a stay in an intensive care unit in the past.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever required a stay in an intensive care unit.

name: patient_has_high_risk_of_asthma_related_death
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a high risk of asthma-related death as defined by the requirement.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has both a near-fatal asthma history and has required a stay in an intensive care unit at any point in the past.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have both a near-fatal asthma history and required ICU stay.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient meets both criteria.

name: patient_is_undergoing_oral_steroid_therapy_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently undergoing oral corticosteroid therapy.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing oral corticosteroid therapy.

name: patient_has_undergone_oral_steroid_therapy_inthepast4weeks
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone oral corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone oral corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone oral corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone oral corticosteroid therapy within the past four weeks.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_omalizumab_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently being treated with (exposed to) omalizumab.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated with (i.e., exposed to) omalizumab.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently being treated with (i.e., not exposed to) omalizumab.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently being treated with omalizumab.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant and this is documented or known.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not pregnant and this is documented or known.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
